notes.title: v1.2.3
notes.notes:
Some minor changes based on feedback received from MagWest 2024

 - Changed 2-1 to be a little more forgiving, and added an alternative easier path
 - Removed wall blocking players from using the red spring on the right-side of level 3-2, and added an extra platform to use
 - Added death planes in tutorial, so players don't need to fall as far to die
 - Fixed name of executable when viewed in sound mixer to be "Super Sushi Roll" and not "A 2D Marble Game"

notes.title: v1.2.2
notes.notes:
Some small changes based on feedback from Magfest 2024

 - Collision inside the bumpers to prevent sushi from bouncing through the bumpers occasionally
 - Renamed "Reset" button to "Reset Level" to prevent thinking it will reset the entire run
 - "Don't Flick" levels (Chopsticks, Bamboo) have been renamed, due to the font making "flick" look like a swear word
 - Larger blockade at the bottom of 3-1 to prevent confusion
 - Extra chopstick in level 3-2 to help with a difficult jump
 - More zoom in level 4-6 to make it more clear where to go
 - Game Over screen displays last level reached
 - Display time with 3 decimal places to match specifications in speedrun.com

notes.title: v1.2.1 small bugfixes
notes.notes:

notes.title: v1.2 - tutorial levels
notes.notes:
[h1]Added[/h1]
 - Four new tutorial levels accessible in the main menu teaching the basics as well as important chopstick techniques
 - Demo is back!

[h1]Changed[/h1]
 - 3-2: Zoom out area increased in the upper sections of level
 - Renamed "Training" to "Level Select"

notes.title: v1.1 - input toggling and minor level tweaks
notes.notes:
[h1]v1.1[/h1]
I found some of the levels - especially in the beginning stages - were a bit too challenging for new players, so I modified a couple of levels to be more generous. Also, you can now swap between controller and keyboard/ mouse input while a controller is connected.

[h3]Added[/h3]
 - Support for toggling between input types (e.g. Keyboard/ mouse, Xbox controller). It will toggle between input types automatically depending on the inputs you enter.
 - Version display on top-left corner of main menu.

[h3]Changed[/h3]
 - Improved error wording during save file integrity check.
 - 1-4: Made ending slightly easier.
 - 1-8: Made moving platform section easier.
 - 3-1: Removed center chopstick on bottom of square.

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
 - 2-1: Bottom spring access if you fall.
 - 4-4: Spot where you could get stuck in spring.

notes.title: New Demo based on PaxWest Feedback
notes.notes:
Updates:
 - Tweaked the majority of Wood Kitchen levels based on PAX West 2023 feedback, the biggest change seen in level 1-2. Overall, the game is more generous to new players still getting the hang of the controls
 - Tutorial system displays how to move the moving platforms in level 1-2
 - Added hitbox to detect if sushi is being squished by moving platforms (you lose a sushi as a result)
 - Level panning is slightly slower
 - Level panning displays controls for how to skip panning at the bottom right
 - Moving platforms can move during level panning
 - Demo timer displays time in HH: MM:SS.00
 - Re-added playtesters in the credits menu
 - Update graphic for in-game UI desserts (at the top left of the screen)
 - Gameplay will pause if your Xbox controller unplugs
 - Gameplay will pause if you activate the Steam overlay
 - Losing a sushi in Training Mode will now add to your Sushi Lost counter

Bug Fixes:
 - Moving platforms now properly follow the path even if you quickly tap the control stick
 - If you lose a sushi during the demo's Classic Mode, that attempt will be added to your demo timer
 - Demo timer no longer resets if you restart level 1-1
 - Yen now properly resets to zero if you collect 30

notes.title: Moving platform rework!
notes.notes:
big things:
 - the moving platforms have changed a lot. you now control them with the same controls as the chopstick. they also move using the physics system, so the sushi ball is now affected by their movement.

minor things:
 - default audio is now 75% (opening was a bit too loud)
 - remove "visualize controls". this feature didn't prove useful.
 - upon out-of-bounds, the sushi will slow down, rather than continuing to fly off.
 - "tween" scrolls menu as well as level complete screen
 - darken dessert in-game ui boxes
 - you can now control the sushi with arrow keys as well as "A" and "D" if using keyboard/ mouse
 - simplify credits
